Reviewing Kinetix Cloud's technical requirements for Lead Product Architect, I identified three common architectural friction points in similar production stacks: unbounded state updates, API waterfall latency, and bundle overhead on mobile devices.

To demonstrate how we eliminate these bottlenecks, I assembled an interactive proof of concept:
Live Demo: https://bieai.vercel.app/demo-fuel50-product-design-lead
Highlights: Sub-second initial paint, optimistic state transitions, strict boundary input validation with Zod.

1. Architecture: Clean separation of concerns with server components for data retrieval and client components only where user interaction occurs.
